acs.text: Activating the `Start Publishing` call to action on the home page opens `/publish`.
Activating `Compare all packages →` on the home page opens `/publish`.
Activating `Browse all published books →` on the home page opens `/books`.

judgements.rationale: Applied user-reach because the home page is the public landing path for visitors, prospective authors, and readers; applied change-frequency because landing-page calls to action and routing are common product-tuning points. Did not apply money, auth, or data-loss because this route is public and read-only.

Applied user-reach because the link routes public visitors into the publishing package comparison flow; applied change-frequency because promotional route labels and destinations are likely to change with merchandising updates. Did not apply money, auth, or data-loss because no transaction, gate, or persisted mutation occurs.

Applied user-reach because the link routes public visitors into the published-books showcase; applied change-frequency because landing-page navigation links are common content and IA change points. Did not apply money, auth, or data-loss because this is a public navigation outcome with no write operation.
